About the Family Medicine Physician event

Family Medicine Physician is a Health Professions event in the HOSA secondary division. Format: speech & presentation · online submission.

Ten in-depth lessons that cover every Family Medicine Physician learning objective (a–f) and every rubric item: what family medicine is, demand and outlook, the education path and career options, work, lifestyle and finances, primary care and health equity, planning the two interviews, telling the physician’s WHY, building a creative peer presentation and presenting to judges in ten minutes. Use the AAFP landing page and the current HOSA guidelines as your official references.
